accepted_changes: Reuse dead scratch after pass12 for the POST-CNB cache; unchanged integer/floating arithmetic and neural schedule
Skip history/reprojected/recurrent clears on reset; retain exposure initialization and clears for non-reset target replacement
interpretation: Average medians move slightly but round ranges overlap; no established steady-frame speedup. Scratch allocation drops 28.5%, and reset-frame medians improve by 0.39–0.52 ms. Targets were not reached.

benchmark.protocol: Serial interleaved rounds, reversed on alternate rounds; median of round means; one warmup sequence per run; full command buffer timestamps; no diagnostic GPU work
